metas.name: Get Huge: Looksmaxxing to Death
metas.description: An unflinching portrait of masculinity in the influencer age, where extreme biohacking, online performance and a series of suspicious deaths converge.

metas.name: Avedon
metas.description: Richard Avedon's photographs didn't just reflect culture, they shaped it, and continue to do so. The feature documentary AVEDON traces the life and legacy of an artist who used fashion, portraiture, and commercial photography to explore identity, power, fear and beauty. With unprecedented access to Avedon's archive, including never before seen photos, behind the scenes recordings, and interviews with those who knew him best, AVEDON is a visually stunning examination of the mind of an artist who shaped our collective image of the 20th century.

metas.name: Nocturne
metas.description: When a victim of serial killer Jurek Walter turns up alive, detective Jonah Lynn races to find the one person still missing, while his protégé Saga Bauer goes undercover for answers from the killer himself. Based on the bestselling novel by Lars Kepler.

metas.name: Cars That Changed History
metas.description:
Cars That Changed History is a 2026 documentary docuseries airing on National Geographic.

Format: 1-season docuseries consisting of 6 episodes exploring engineering breakthroughs, historic rivalries, and the social impact of iconic vehicles.

metas.name: Swipe Right on the Devil
metas.description: Revisits the 2017 murder of 24-year-old Sydney Loofe, who disappeared and was later found dead after going on a Tinder date with Bailey Boswell.

metas.name: Super Scam Me
metas.description: After years of reporting on the scam industry, Mariana van Zeller enters one of her most immersive investigations to date. In a real-life social experiment, she builds a new online dating persona and goes undercover as the target of a romance scam to understand and expose the tactics, technologies, and psychological manipulations these criminals utilize to deceive their victims.

metas.name: Free Leonard Peltier
metas.description: Leonard Peltier, an activist jailed for decades after a disputed conviction, faces his twilight years as a new generation fights for his release from prison before it's too late.

metas.name: Cupertino
metas.description: A scrappy lawyer takes on a powerful tech giant in a high-stakes legal battle, navigating the cutthroat world of Silicon Valley while fighting for justice and the little guy's rights.

metas.name: The Serial Killer Connection
metas.description: The ex-wife and survivor of serial killer Richard "Marc" Evonitz unite to uncover his untold life and crimes and as they dig deeper, they confront the chilling possibility that the full scope of his crimes has yet to be revealed.

metas.name: Carrie
metas.description: After her father's sudden, untimely death thrusts her into the unforgiving ecosystem of public high school, Carrie is forced to navigate a viral bullying scandal that tears through her community, the relentless pressure and casual cruelty of the social‑media age, and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers that rise alongside her adolescence.

metas.name: The Last First: Winter K2
metas.description: K2's first winter ascent claimed 5 lives, revealing modern alpinism's struggles with commercialization, social media impact, and conflicts between marginalized climbers and traditional elites.

metas.name: Africa Earth's Wild Home
metas.description: Captures unprecedented behaviors, examine continental forces, and highlight life's adaptations. Features National Geographic Explorers and scientists working to understand and protect Africa's wildlife.

metas.name: The Widower: 'Til Death Do Us Part
metas.description: A journalist and a detective uncover the truth about a killer whose charm masked a trail of failed marriages and suspicious deaths.

metas.name: The Swan: Behind the Mirror
metas.description: A look at the controversial 2004 reality series The Swan, which took self-proclaimed 'ugly ducklings' and set out to make them... not that.

metas.name: Chilean Mine Rescue: Race Against Time
metas.description: Following a mining accident in northern Chile, 33 miners are trapped deep underground. As the search for them begins, the men are fighting for their lives under extreme conditions.

metas.name: Tribeca 25
metas.description: Twenty-five years after 9/11, Tribeca 25 chronicles how Robert De Niro and Jane Rosenthal transformed an ambitious effort to revive Lower Manhattan into one of the world's leading cultural institutions. Through rare archival footage, exclusive interviews and behind-the-scenes access, the film explores how art can foster community, confront injustice, and help shape culture.

metas.name: A Killer Story
metas.description: Investigative journalist Joe Sexton looks into a 2002 double homicide case in Kansas after receiving thousands of emails from Eileen Umbehr, a homemaker turned citizen sleuth. Eileen and her husband Keen are convinced that Dana Chandler, the woman accused of killing her ex-husband and his girlfriend, did not commit the crime and devote their lives to fighting for Chandler's innocence.

metas.name: Band of Brothers: Legacy
metas.description: This tribute to the groundbreaking series that helped preserve the story of Easy Company and deepened public appreciation for the sacrifices of the Greatest Generation features new interviews with cast members Damian Lewis, Ron Livingston, Michael Cudlitz, Capt. Dale Dye, USMC (Ret.), David Schwimmer, and more. Through personal reflections and behind-the-scenes stories, participants revisit the experience of making the series and explore its lasting cultural resonance, and also includes never-before-seen archival footage and photographs of Easy Company and World War II.

metas.name: Last Seen
metas.description: Police dispatcher Ian Ridley's daughter Maggie disappeared years ago. He receives a call, believing it's her, and embarks on a relentless quest to find her and reunite his family, disregarding consequences.

metas.name: Welcome to the Family: The Murder of Dan Markel
metas.description: Explores the murder of Florida attorney and law professor Dan Markel. A brutal murder reveals the dark secrets of a wealthy Florida family.

metas.name: The Last Salute
metas.description: Chronicles the MiG-21's final chapter in the Indian Air Force, showcasing stories of generations of fighter pilots who flew it.

metas.name: Death of the Pastor's Wife
metas.description: What happened to Mica Miller? This documentary series retraces her promising life, toxic marriage and the mysterious circumstances of her death.

metas.name: World's Most Evil Women
metas.description: World's Most Evil Women unmasks those who traded compassion for cruelty, committing acts so horrific they shattered entire communities.

metas.name: Conversations with a Killer: The Charles Manson Tapes
metas.description: Follows cult leader Charles Manson's rise, the 1969 murders committed by the Manson Family, and the 1971 trial through unreleased prison recordings, firsthand accounts, and interviews.

metas.name: The End of Oak Street
metas.description: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

metas.name: Somebody Knows Something
metas.description: Former law enforcement officer Kara Chamberlain investigates unsolved murders and missing persons cases, working with victims' families, police and online communities to generate new leads.

metas.name: Monsters of God
metas.description: A gripping documentary explores the shadowy world of exotic reptile smuggling, following two rival kingpins whose lucrative global operation supplied rare species to US zoos until betrayal sparked a devastating vendetta.

metas.name: The Shards
metas.description: The Shards is part teenage coming of age, erotic thriller and exploration of the untamed and mysterious era of Los Angeles 1981, tracking a group of privileged high school friends as a serial killer strikes across the city.

metas.name: Furious
metas.description: FBI agent Alice Black is on the hunt for a mysterious and calculating female serial killer. Both walk their own paths toward justice, and as their lives start to intertwine, the line between right and wrong begins to blur.

metas.name: Instadocs: The Prediction Games
metas.description: Prediction markets let anyone bet on anything, from the World Cup to alien invasions. "Instadocs" investigates the explosive rise of global betting.
